title: Measure bias and variance
summary: Fit polynomials of degree 1 to 12 on resampled training sets and measure bias squared, variance and test error at each degree.

mutants.no_noise_term: Leaves the noise variance out of the test error.
mutants.same_seed_each_round: Uses the same seed in every round, so every training set is the same and the variance is 0.
mutants.square_of_mean_bias: Squares the mean error over the test points, not the mean of the squared errors.
mutants.strict_crossover: Uses a strict greater than, so a degree with equal bias and variance is not the crossover.
mutants.ties_pick_higher: Visits the degrees from high to low, so a tie picks the higher degree.
mutants.variance_ddof_1: Divides the variance by B minus 1, so the error no longer equals bias plus variance plus noise.
